places: Zambezi , Angola, Namibia, Zimbabwe, and Mozambique [m]
junction of the Limpopo and Shashe Rivers

fields.climate: semiarid; warm winters and hot summers
fields.terrain: predominantly flat to gently rolling tableland; Kalahari Desert in southwest
fields.hazards: periodic droughts; seasonal August winds blow from the west, carrying sand and dust across the country, which can obscure visibility
fields.resources: diamonds, copper, nickel, salt, soda ash, potash, coal, iron ore, silver
fields.farm: root vegetables, beef, vegetables, sorghum, maize, game meat, milk, watermelons, goat milk, sunflower seeds
fields.exports: diamonds, copper ore, insulated wire, carbonates, cattle
fields.industries: diamonds, copper, nickel, salt, soda ash, potash, coal, iron ore, silver; beef processing; textiles
fields.languages: Setswana 77.3%, Sekalanga 7.4%, Shekgalagadi 3.4%, English (official) 2.8%, Zezuru/Shona 2%, Sesarwa 1.7%, Sembukushu 1.6%, Ndebele 1%, other 2.8%
fields.religions: Christian 79.1%, Badimo 4.1%, other 1.4% (includes Baha'i, Hindu, Muslim, Rastafarian), none 15.2%, unspecified 0.3%
fields.legal: mixed legal system of civil law influenced by the Roman-Dutch model, including customary and common law
fields.military: 18-24 years of age (men and women) for general recruits and officer candidates; 18-40 for special entrant officers; no conscription
